svg.title: Exhibit: SereneDB challenge winner
svg.desc: Exhibit, our winning project at the schubKI National AI Hackathon 2026. Role-aware log intelligence over SereneDB, built in 48 hours by team Logging off Early: @Arnie1x and me. SQL computes, the LLM explains: every number comes with its query. 15/15 eval questions match golden SQL. 13 ms phrase + facet search over 5.28M rows. ~20 s full rebuild from raw logs. 48 h team of two, 200+ participants. Log lines parsed and indexed: OTel slice 5,275,597, BGL 4,747,963, OpenStack 207,812 (OTel: a 10-s slice of a 1B-row file). Incidents found at an episode gap of 1 min: 132, 5 min: 117, 60 min: 57. 152,734 'data TLB error interrupt' lines, 99.64% of them from one node.
